interface.longDescription: Build arguments and inspect revisions. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Arrange a claim and evidence; Compare two drafts; Inspect sentence length and repetition. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me arrange a claim and evidence.

prompts: Help me arrange a claim and evidence.
Help me inspect sentence length and repetition.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Draft Path: Writing workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Arrange a claim and evidence. Reproducible inputs: {"claim":"The park needs more shade.","evidence":[{"quote":"Only two benches have trees nearby.","source":"Our observation","reason":"Most seating is exposed."}]}
positive.prompt: Help me arrange a claim and evidence with these supplied values: {"claim":"The park needs more shade.","evidence":[{"quote":"Only two benches have trees nearby.","source":"Our observation","reason":"Most seating is exposed."}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses writing_workshop_argument_board with the supplied inputs. Returns {"claim":"The park needs more shade.","cards":[{"number":1,"quote":"Only two benches have trees nearby.","source":"Our observation","reason":"Most seating is exposed.","reason_words":4}],"outline":["The park needs more shade.","Only two benches have trees nearby. (Our observation) — Most seating is exposed.","Counterargument: add a competing view and response."]}. Shows the actual kanban result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare two drafts. Reproducible inputs: {"before":"The park is nice. It is really very nice.","after":"The park offers shaded paths and quiet benches."}
positive.prompt: Help me compare two drafts with these supplied values: {"before":"The park is nice. It is really very nice.","after":"The park offers shaded paths and quiet benches."}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses writing_workshop_revision_compare with the supplied inputs. Returns {"before_words":9,"after_words":8,"change":-1,"added":["offers","shaded","paths","and","quiet","benches"],"removed":["is","nice","it","really","very"],"before":"The park is nice. It is really very nice.","after":"The park offers shaded paths and quiet benches."}. Shows the actual diff result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Inspect sentence length and repetition. Reproducible inputs: {"draft":"The garden is quiet. The garden is green. Visitors can sit beneath the old oak tree and read while birds gather around the fountain.","long_sentence_words":15}
positive.prompt: Help me inspect sentence length and repetition with these supplied values: {"draft":"The garden is quiet. The garden is green. Visitors can sit beneath the old oak tree and read while birds gather around the fountain.","long_sentence_words":15}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses writing_workshop_sentence_audit with the supplied inputs. Returns {"sentences":[{"number":1,"text":"The garden is quiet.","words":4,"review":false},{"number":2,"text":"The garden is green.","words":4,"review":false},{"number":3,"text":"Visitors can sit beneath the old oak tree and read while birds gather around the fountain.","words":16,"review":true}],"repeated_words":[{"word":"garden","count":2}],"note":"Mechanical revision cues, not an essay grade."}. Shows the actual editor result. Does not fabricate external data.
